invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of HoodieJavaTable.create, which should not return null under normal usage.
The factory method returns a HoodieJavaTable<T> instance.
config is dereferenced in the method body (e.g., config.getBasePath()), so it cannot be null at method exit.
context is dereferenced via context.getStorageConf(), ensuring it cannot be null.
The static create method constructs and returns an instance directly of HoodieJavaTable.
